name: TD-3 Switch Coherence
description: Top-down context-assurance test (TOP_DOWN_REVIEW_GUIDE.md §4, TD-3): run the same real regulated-topic prompt twice — once against the default/primary configured model, once with a model_override forcing the local fallback (BitNet-class) — then compare both real capture-store entries for decision coherence over the identical traversed context. Productizes this session's BitNet coherency-sweep methodology as a standing, registered test rather than a one-off manual sweep.

steps.description: Submit a real RequireConfirmation-matching prompt through /orchestrate on the default configured model (no override) to establish the baseline decision and reasoning. Hands on task_id_primary. Submitting needs an orchestrate-call capability that is not registered.
steps.name: submit_with_primary_model

steps.description: Submit the identical prompt again with a model_config override forcing the local BitNet-class fallback for the review call. Hands on task_id_fallback.
steps.name: submit_with_forced_fallback

steps.description: Read both capture-store lines ({data_dir}/model_calls/decision_review.jsonl) and compare decision agreement and whether the fallback's reasoning still cites the same traversed-context markers as the primary's. Hands on a coherence report.
steps.name: compare_capture_entries
